close_active_refused: Task {id} cannot be closed. The user has an unfinished request in Agent “{agent}” ({activity}).
latest_owner_message: Latest owner message to this Agent: “{message}”
close_active_choices: Use task_scope to add the requirement to the completion criteria, ask the Agent to finish or stop the follow-up, or use needs_user to ask the owner.
close_active_confirm: The Agent “{agent}” is still monitoring or has work scheduled. Mark “{title}” complete anyway?
accept_active_confirm: The Agent “{agent}” is still monitoring or has work scheduled. Pass the review and close “{title}” anyway?
latest_agent_message: Your latest message to this Agent was “{message}”.
close_not_confirmed: The task stays open until you confirm. Its Agent is still monitoring or has work scheduled.
complete_card: Mark the task “{title}” done (its agents are closed once they are idle)
supervision_needs_deployment: Merged; deployment and live verification still required
someday_closed: Only an open to-do can be put off to Someday
someday_until: Pick a time ahead, no later than the year 9999
round_not_found: That part of the to-do's conversation is no longer there
agent_not_listed: This Agent isn't listed on its computer yet. Try again in a moment.
not_told_yet: This to-do can't be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
machine_not_found: This computer isn't one of the hub's computers.
machine_offline: This computer is off right now. Try again once it's back.
images_forbidden: This device can’t read to-do images
reorganize_requires_v2: Turn on New To-dos & Tasks in Labs to reorganize to-dos.
topology_changed: The to-do changed. Refresh your to-dos and try again.
split_children_changed: Some to-dos from this split were moved or removed. Refresh your to-dos before splitting again.
